top_signals.title: Oil Prices Rebound as Middle East Supply Fears Return
top_signals.summary: January WTI crude oil futures recovered from a three-month low this week as renewed concern over Middle East supply brought buyers back into the market. Prices had fallen early in the week as traders focused on the prospect of a global surplus. The selling slowed after WTI reached $79.07, and the market rallied Wednesday after Yemen’s Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Arabia’s Ras Tanura refinery. At 00:09 GMT Thursday, January WTI crude oil futures were trading at $84.01, up $0.60 or 0.72% for the week. The contract had traded as…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Iran Says LNG Carrier Exploded After Hitting a Mine in Hormuz
top_signals.summary: An LNG vessel has caught fire and exploded after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz during an attempt to transit on a route deemed “illegal” by Iran, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy said in the latest communication of a tanker incident in the chokepoint. The LNG carrier had switched off its positioning systems and attempted to use “an unauthorized U.S.-Israeli-designated route,” the IRGC Navy’s Public Relations Office said, as carried by Iranian media early on Thursday. top_signals.title: Channel 4 in talks to sell London HQ to property developer Socius
top_signals.summary: Channel 4 is in talks to sell its longstanding London headquarters for more than £50m as the broadcaster grapples with a cash squeeze and a downturn in television advertising. Property developer Socius has entered exclusive negotiations to acquire the broadcaster’s Horseferry Road base in Pimlico, Sky News reported on Thursday. A deal is not guaranteed, [...]
